name: r04_four_fillets_remain
why: Four R5 fillets on the vertical edges, and the plate gets longer. The fillets have no position of their own: they follow the edges. It is the case that MUST hold, and it serves to tell «the check works» from «everything comes off».
intent_why: a fillet on an edge is anchored to the edge by construction: lengthening the part moves two of the four, and four fillets of 5 remain. Here we measure that they are still there, and that they are still 5.

after.tolerance_why: four cylindrical faces of radius 5: the diameter is read from CylinderParams in metres
